core_obligations: (1)=>(2): Omega_{X/Y,x} = 0 iff unramified at x (Morphisms, complete citation).
(1)=>(4): the diagonal Delta is a local isomorphism at x iff unramified (derived: Delta is an immersion; its conormal is Omega; local iso iff vanishing).
(4)=>(2): a local iso of the diagonal kills the stalk of Omega (citation).
(3)=>(2): from the embedding, d g generate Omega_{A^n_V/V} at i(x), so the conormal of i generates; stalk Omega_{X/Y,x} = 0 (citation plus stalk computation).

(2)=>(3): real affine construction: localize, take a finite-type presentation with d(f_j) generating the kernel of the differentiation module, and build the closed immersion into A^n_V with the required generating property.
